Microsoft Edge WebView2 SDK, the parts Dockside's Windows build uses (src\webview.cpp):

  include\WebView2.h              the COM interfaces
  x64\WebView2LoaderStatic.lib    the loader, linked into Dockside.exe (no WebView2Loader.dll beside it)
  LICENSE.txt                     the SDK's licence (BSD-style, Microsoft Corporation)

From the NuGet package Microsoft.Web.WebView2 1.0.4314.35 (published 2026-10-23),
https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.Web.WebView2/1.0.4314.35
package sha256 90778deb1b77e36292828b4b5833c9255c27533f40e0ddd55891ae718944edc4
(build\native\include\WebView2.h and build\native\x64\WebView2LoaderStatic.lib in it).

The browser itself is not here: it is the WebView2 Runtime Windows installs and updates
(C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\EdgeWebView\Application). Without it Dockside opens the
system's browser instead.
